# Apache HTTPD (AJP) — custom-to-root-context-servlet-mapping-sse

AJP proxy at /app/ui/, app at root / with VAADIN_URL_MAPPING=/ui/*, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. Prefix stripping, a custom servlet mapping and Hilla resources at the context root, all over AJP with no WebSocket bypass.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# AJP proxy at /app/ui/, app at root / with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*.
# The hardest combination in the catalogue: prefix stripping, a custom servlet
# mapping and Hilla resources at the context root, all over AJP.
#
# The WebSocket sibling needs a server-scope RewriteRule to bypass AJP for
# upgrades; here there is none, because SSE rides AJP like every other request.
#
# Hilla browser-callables (/connect/*) and Hilla push (/HILLA/*) live at the
# backend root, not under /ui (see vaadin/hilla#289).
ProxyPass         /app/ui/HILLA/    ajp://vaadin:8009/HILLA/ flushpackets=on
ProxyPass         /app/ui/connect/  ajp://vaadin:8009/connect/ flushpackets=on
ProxyPass         /app/             ajp://vaadin:8009/ flushpackets=on
ProxyPassReverseCookiePath "/" "/app"
```
